content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hello,

I have reviewed the agreement and would like to suggest a clarification to one clause:

- The relevant clause reads: "Provider shall notify Client immediately if project scope changes threaten to exceed $150,000.00 USD." This could allow work beyond the budget without a formal change order or additional payment. I propose that any change to the scope that would increase the estimated budget shall require a written change order signed by both parties, specifying the additional compensation.

Thank you for your consideration.
